themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and execute complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, often integrated into IDEs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered software and platforms designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI applications that condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, saving time and effort.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic real users for testing and research.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques used to assist in the design process, from concept generation to UI creation.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Concerns articles that review, benchmark, or compare various AI tools and platforms for UX and research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skills, and employment landscapes, particularly within research and design fields.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers research and findings related to the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discusses how AI is being applied to streamline product management workflows, strategy, and decision-making.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
